$comment: Test files the census lane accepts as unreachable by the hermetic gate, each with the reason
recorded so the exemption is a decision rather than an oversight. Liveness rule, enforced by
the lane: an entry whose file no longer exists, or whose file the gate can now reach, is a
stale exemption and fails the lane.

exempt.reason: //go:build cgo -- live Oracle tests. Compiled into the live-oracle Docker lane's test binary; the hermetic lanes run with CGO_ENABLED=0 and must never reach it.

Current-state debt measured 2026-08-08: //go:build integration && cgo is compiled by no current lane. The hermetic integration lane excludes cgo; the live-oracle binary build passes no -tags=integration. D7 must re-adjudicate whether/how this test belongs in the target runtime verification topology; until then the census names it explicitly instead of letting it hide.
